name: Nosferatu
summary: A hidden-role team game where hunters try to cast rituals or stake the vampire before Renfield delivers five bites.
rules_text: Players are secretly Hunters, one Vampire, and one Renfield who knows all identities and distributes them. A Clock pile of N Night plus one Dawn and a Library of Incantations, Bites, Nights and Newspapers is made. Each round the Ancestral Stake holder starts, then clockwise each player draws two Library cards into a hidden hand, gives one face-down to Renfield and discards one face-up. After each turn Renfield reveals a Clock card; Night continues, Dawn ends the round immediately. At round end Renfield shuffles the given cards: Bites are placed in front of chosen players and Renfield discards a card from their hand unseen; all Incantations together trigger a Ritual chosen by Stake holder; Nights go to Clock pile; Newspapers do nothing. If Dawn ended the round, Stake holder may reveal one character card: Vampire means Hunters win, Hunter means Evil wins. Five Rituals Hunters win, five Bites Evil wins, four Bites in 5-player game.
rating_reason: Hidden role card passing to Renfield, incantations vs bites
